## Summary

## Systems affected

- [ ] Startup / error handling
- [ ] Accounts / saves / XML

- [ ] Gameplay / AI / objectives

## Compatibility checklist

- [ ] Root `index.html` still loads as the GitHub Pages homepage.
- [ ] Existing storage keys, account IDs, and save fields are unchanged or migrated safely.
- [ ] Existing room links, six-digit codes, and invite parameters remain compatible.
- [ ] Root compatibility files still route to their canonical implementations.
- [ ] Portable build parity has been checked.
- [ ] No private account, room, WebRTC, IP, token, or inventory data was added to reports or tests.

## Validation

## Screenshots or reports
